root_selection_decision.question: Can four equal225mm2 contacts distributed around the top outer shell, while preserving a3.75mm interpad gap, reduce cross-carrier surface overlap without losing absolute deep-ROI modulation under original eight skin/contact caps?
root_selection_decision.rationale: Actual tangential return translation narrowed minimumgap to1.25mm and failedall8screens atcontactpowerlimit (mean3.98845/P103.59624/SP9531.53689). Samegeometrycoherent voltage mixing improvedtarget but increasedofftargets. Change contactoutline+placement together while preserving original4square padareas/totalarea/pads/outputcount/circuit/phantom, rather than further narrowing gap or increasing source freedom.
root_selection_decision.selection_count: 571+6-1=576; removeoutermost selecteddiagonal(67,67) fromouterboundary; innermostdiagonal variant rejected due closed1facehole
root_selection_decision.coordinate_geometry: Topz0;h.625/nativecelllowercorner(-25+i*h,-25+j*h). Q1 fullface cornersinsideD50 andx_min,y_min>=1.875mm. Rankcentre integer(2i-79)^2+(2j-79)^2 descending, preservewholecutofforbits, removeoutermostdiagonal. Rotatefixedphysicalfaceunion toQ3pad0(signalout0),Q1pad1(signalout1),Q4pad2GND,Q2pad3GND.
root_selection_decision.geometry_contract: Fixedphysical stepped unionof576fullgridface rectangles perpad,one4-neighbourcomponent,noholes; exactouterboundary diagonalnotch. Not a smoothannulararc orstrictmostradial576. Futuremeshrefinement mustrepresentthissamephysicaloutline,notrerankcellsandchangethecontactshape. Combinedshape+placementcontrast,notisolatedshapeeffect.
